svg.title: The point: building systems that make real impact

g.text: I build systems that make real impact.
I'm Anugrah, an AI/ML engineer in training. I care about outcomes, not just demos. A system earns
its place when it helps someone make a better decision, move faster, or carry less friction. That is
The last 20 percent is the product.
If the boundary is confusing, it is not
